interpretation.baseline: The baseline phase restores the complete original cuda_ipc_cache.c at 74b413ab19d63c277ffa3fb553ed83e42bc50f6f and rebuilds the CUDA module. All other runtime source is identical to that base. This control does not use a mocked driver or an adapted operations table.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ucx_validation_root=$PWD
cd source
./autogen.sh > ../logs/autogen.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_validation_root"
mkdir build
cd build
../source/contrib/configure-devel --prefix="$ucx_validation_root/install/candidate" \
    --without-go --without-java --without-rocm --with-mpi --disable-static \
    --with-cuda=/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1 --with-gdrcopy=/usr \
    CC=/usr/bin/gcc CXX=/usr/bin/g++ CFLAGS='-O1 -g' CXXFLAGS='-O1 -g' \
    > ../logs/configure.log 2>&1
ucx_link_flags="-Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucp/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/uct/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucs/.libs -Wl,-rpath-link,$PWD/src/ucm/.libs"
make -j16 LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/build.log 2>&1
make install LDFLAGS="$ucx_link_flags" > ../logs/install.log 2>&1
cd "$ucx_validation_root"
cc -shared -fPIC -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include ipc_trace.c -ldl -pthread -o ipc_trace.so
mpicc -O2 -g -I/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/include mpi_repro.c -L/opt/devtools/nvidia/cuda-12.9.1/lib64 -lcudart -o mpi_repro

from pathlib import Path
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, '/org/org-open-sai/proj-sai-hpc-software/ucx-ipc-20261110-a/control')
from suite import node_info
node_info(root / 'runs', 4)
report = {'job': os.environ['SLURM_JOB_ID'], 'cases': [], 'phases': {},
          'tested_commit': (root / 'tested-commit.txt').read_text().strip()}
source = root / 'source/src/uct/cuda/cuda_ipc/cuda_ipc_cache.c'
candidate = source.read_bytes()
hashes = json.loads((root / 'source-hashes.json').read_text())
for name, digest in hashes.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / 'source' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
report['source_sha256'] = hashes


def record():
    (root / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')


def run(name, command, env=None, expected=0):
    log = root / 'logs' / (name + '.log')
    with log.open('w') as stream:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=stream,
                                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    text = log.read_text(errors='replace')
    item = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
            'expected': expected, 'log': str(log.relative_to(root)),
            'accepted': result.returncode == expected}
    report['cases'].append(item)
    record()
    print(json.dumps(item), flush=True)
    assert item['accepted'], text[-4000:]
    return text, item


def phase(name):
    report['phases'][name] = {
        'cache_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'cuda_module_sha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'install/candidate/lib/ucx/libuct_cuda.so.0.0.0').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    }
    record()


def rebuild(name, contents):
    source.write_bytes(contents)
    run(name + '-build', ['make', '-C', str(root / 'build/src/uct/cuda'), '-j8'])
    run(name + '-install', ['make', '-C', str(root / 'build/src/uct/cuda'), 'install'])
    phase(name)


def hardware(name, mode, expected=0, errors=0):
    case = root / 'runs' / name
    (case / 'trace').mkdir(parents=True)
    executable = {
        'normal': root.parent / 'ucx-review-probe-20261113/build-candidate/test/mpi/.libs/test_cuda_ipc_overlap',
        'native': root / 'mpi_repro',
        'mpi-matrix': root / 'build/test/mpi/.libs/test_mpi_cuda'
    }[mode]
    cmd = ['timeout', '--kill-after=10', '180', 'mpirun', '-np', '2', '--bind-to', 'none']
    if mode == 'normal':
        cmd += ['-mca', 'pml', 'ob1', '-mca', 'osc', '^ucx', '-mca', 'btl', 'tcp,self',
                '-mca', 'btl_tcp_if_include', 'lo', '-mca', 'coll', '^hcoll,ml,ucc']
    cmd += ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(root / 'rank.py'), name, 'candidate', mode, str(executable)]
    text, item = run(name, cmd, expected=expected)
    item['executable_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(executable.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if mode == 'mpi-matrix':
        item['passed'] = len(re.findall(r': PASS', text))
        item['skipped'] = len(re.findall(r': SKIP', text))
        assert item['passed'] == 450 and item['skipped'] == 36 and ': FAIL' not in text, item
    elif mode == 'normal':
        assert f'lower overlaps=30, UCX errors/warnings={errors}; data checks passed' in text, text[-4000:]
    else:
        assert 'PASS exact data checks; lower_overlap_count=30' in text, text[-4000:]
    traces = list((case / 'trace').glob('ipc-r[01]-*.log'))
    assert len(traces) == 2, traces
    counts = collections.Counter()
    item['library_maps'] = []
    for trace in traces:
        content = trace.read_text()
        counts.update(re.findall(r'^\d+ open result=(\d+)\b', content, re.M))
        libs = sorted({line.split()[-1] for line in content.splitlines()
                       if line.startswith('MAP ') and re.search(r'/lib(?:ucs|ucp|uct|ucm)(?:[._])', line)})
        assert libs and all(lib.startswith(str(root / 'install/candidate') + '/') for lib in libs), libs
        item['library_maps'].append(libs)
    if mode != 'mpi-matrix':
        assert counts['0'] == 60 and counts['208'] == errors, counts
        assert sum(n for c, n in counts.items() if c != '0') == errors, counts
        item['lower_overlaps'] = 30
    item['driver_open_results'] = dict(counts)
    record()


phase('candidate')
env = os.environ.copy()
env['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES'] = ''
env['UCX_HANDLE_ERRORS'] = 'bt'
text, item = run('existing-cache-gtests', ['timeout', '180', 'make', '-C', str(root / 'build/test/gtest'),
                 'test', 'GTEST_FILTER=test_cuda_ipc_cache_lru.*',
                 'GTEST_EXTRA_ARGS=--gtest_shuffle --gtest_random_seed=2026'], env=env)
item['passed'] = len(re.findall(r'^\[       OK \]', text, re.M))
item['gpu_visibility'] = ''
assert item['passed'] == 6 and '[  FAILED  ]' not in text and '[  SKIPPED ]' not in text
record()
try:
    rebuild('original-runtime', (root / 'baseline-cache.c').read_bytes())
    hardware('baseline-direct-uct', 'normal', expected=1, errors=30)
    hardware('baseline-mpi', 'native', errors=30)
finally:
    rebuild('candidate-restored', candidate)
hardware('candidate-direct-uct', 'normal')
hardware('candidate-mpi', 'native')
hardware('candidate-mpi-matrix', 'mpi-matrix')
assert report['phases']['candidate']['cache_source_sha256'] == report['phases']['candidate-restored']['cache_source_sha256']
for name, digest in hashes.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / 'source' / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest, name
report['status'] = 'PASS'
record()
print('VALIDATION PASS', flush=True)

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import sys

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
case_name,variant,mode,executable=sys.argv[1:]
case=root/'runs'/case_name
inventory=json.loads((root/'runs/nodes'/(socket.gethostname().split('.')[0]+'.json')).read_text())
rank=int(os.environ['OMPI_COMM_WORLD_LOCAL_RANK'])
devices=inventory['devices']
device=devices[0 if mode=='same-gpu' else rank]['uuid']
if mode in ('mpi-matrix','native'): device=','.join(d['uuid'] for d in devices)
if mode=='no-gpu' or (mode=='one-no-gpu' and rank==1): device=''
prefix=root/'install'/variant
os.environ['CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES']=device
os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(prefix/'lib')+':'+str(prefix/'lib/ucx')+':'+os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']
os.environ['UCX_MODULE_DIR']=str(prefix/'lib/ucx')
os.environ['UCX_LOG_LEVEL']='warn'
os.environ['LD_PRELOAD']=str(root/'ipc_trace.so')
os.environ['SAI_UCX_TRACE_PATH']=str(case/'trace')
if mode in ('no-ipc','one-no-ipc') and (mode=='no-ipc' or rank==1):
    os.environ['UCX_MODULES']='^*'
if mode=='quiet-log': os.environ['UCX_LOG_LEVEL']='fatal'
injections={
    'unsupported':(1,801), 'too-many-peers':(1,711), 'peer-unsupported':(1,217),
    'initial-import-error':(1,1), 'later-import-error':(2,1), 'later-unsupported':(2,801),
    'legacy-diagnostic-error':(1,1), 'fallback':(2,208),
    'changed-warning':(2,0), 'initial-warning':(1,0), 'outside-warning':(0,0),
    'close-error':(0,0), 'data-corruption':(0,0),
    'legacy-probe-blocked':(0,0), 'legacy-probe-blocked-old':(0,0)
}
if mode in injections:
    os.environ['LD_PRELOAD']=str(root/'inject.so')+':'+os.environ['LD_PRELOAD']
    when,code=injections[mode]
    os.environ['TEST_INJECT_CALL']=str(when)
    if mode=='data-corruption': os.environ['TEST_CORRUPT_DATA']='1'
    elif mode=='outside-warning': os.environ['TEST_OUTSIDE_WARNING']='1'
    elif mode=='close-error': os.environ['TEST_CLOSE_ERROR']='1'
    elif mode in ('changed-warning','initial-warning'): os.environ['TEST_INJECT_WARNING']='1'
    elif mode.startswith('legacy-probe-blocked'): os.environ['TEST_BLOCK_LEGACY_PROBE']='1'
    else: os.environ['TEST_INJECT_CODE']=str(code)
    if mode in ('unsupported','too-many-peers','peer-unsupported','legacy-diagnostic-error'):
        os.environ['TEST_INJECT_PERSISTENT']='1'
if mode in ('native','mpi-matrix'):
    os.environ['OMPI_MCA_pml']='ucx'
    os.environ['OMPI_MCA_pml_ucx_tls']='any'
if mode=='native':
    os.environ['UCX_TLS']='sm,self,cuda_copy,cuda_ipc'
    os.environ['UCX_RNDV_THRESH']='1'
    os.environ['UCX_RNDV_SCHEME']='get_zcopy'
(case/('rank-'+str(rank)+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(gpu_uuid=device,variant=variant,host=socket.gethostname(),affinity=sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),mode=mode)))
os.execv(executable,[executable])
